text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 1. Light baffle between the grain LEDs and the photodiode of the FR-4 build. (The printed PA12 base
plate GL1-012 carries the same ring itself, on three spokes.)
2. PRINTED 1.1 high as a sprued set (print file). WE cut the rings off, trim the gate
flush and LAP the bonding face in a pocket gauge. Finished height = measured plate thickness t
(over the mask) + 0.15 - thickness of the black tape used (E16: 0.1 to 0.145 as available),
+0.00 / -0.03: 0.82 for a 0.8 plate and a 0.13 tape (drawn). The crest then ends
z 0.00 to 0.13 above the base plane and can never stand proud of it. (Lapped to
0.82 regardless of the plate it could end at z -0.03 to 0.22.) The crest is the as-printed face.
3. Wall 0.8 mm (the printing minimum). Order two sets.
4. ASSEMBLY, before the base plate is laminated: PCB component-side down in the lamination jig on
its two sprung pins; annulus onto the ring; the ring tool, registered on the same two pins, places
the ring round the photodiode (0.59 mm to the photodiode corners and to the LEDs). After
lamination: crest between the base plane and 0.15 mm inside it, read with the BRIDGE
GAUGE on its three feet round the ball feet (bare mask; never from the legend). Then the
opening is potted clear: surface from the crest to 0.1 inside it, never nearer the base
5. Ring and annulus black and opaque at the LED wavelengths, low fluorescence: light-leak test
(0.8 mm dyed MJF PA12; a clear tape would be a light slot between LEDs and photodiode).
6. PROVISIONAL - not released. Nothing has been built.
